title: Support & Escalation Readiness
objective: Menyiapkan intake, severity, response ownership, recovery guidance, dan escalation path.

P0.definition: Kehilangan/korupsi data yang dapat direproduksi, credential exposure, atau bypass boundary keamanan

P1.definition: Project tidak dapat dibuka atau core workflow terblokir tanpa workaround aman

P2.definition: Fungsi salah dengan workaround aman; tidak ada kehilangan data

P0.action: Stop distribution, hentikan kandidat, mulai investigation

P1.action: Investigate, mulai fix, document workaround jika ada

recovery_guides.scenario: Crash on startup or session lock

escalation_paths.trigger: P0 data loss or security incident
escalation_paths.action: Immediate halt of distribution, notify Choirudin, begin hotfix
escalation_paths.communication: Direct channel, no public disclosure until resolved

escalation_paths.action: Investigate root cause, provide workaround or patch

escalation_paths.trigger: Multiple P2 issues from same workflow
escalation_paths.action: Review for systemic issue, escalate to P1 if pattern found

escalation_paths.trigger: External dependency failure (AI provider, OS update)
escalation_paths.action: Document workaround, notify users via release notes

limits: Support playbook ini mendefinisikan kerangka triage dan escalation, bukan jaminan resolusi.
Choirudin adalah decision maker untuk semua P0 dan P1 keputusan.
Tidak ada public support channel yang dioperasikan — support dilakukan secara langsung.
Hosted CI, public release, dan distribusi eksternal tetap DEFERRED.
